from collections import Counter

def transform(grid, dot=None):
    """ARC task-5c839a47: a background cell becomes 3 iff it is strictly
    between two dots (least-common color) in its row OR in its column
    (between min and max dot index of that row/column). Dots stay unchanged.

    if dot is None:
        dot = Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common()[-1][0]
    hh, ww = len(grid), len(grid[0])

        for j in range(ww):
            v = grid[i][j]

            colc = [i2 for i2 in range(hh) if grid[i2][j] == dot]
            between = ((len(rowc) > 1 and min(rowc) < j < max(rowc)) or

        out.append(row)
